posts.name: Arcanist Lupus
posts.cooked:
The goal of this thread is to calculate the maximum amount of damage you can deal in the first round of play.
 

You can choose any five heros and stack their decks in any order.  Assume the villan is Akash'buta and she played an irrelevent one shot for her opening move.  The environment doesn't do anything either.

 

I can do 62 damage using Legacy, Argent Adept, Visionary, Omnitron X, and Absolute Zero.  (Actually, I think I can get higher, but I'd need to look through OmniX's deck, which I don't have with me at the moment.)  Can anybody top that?

 

 

 

 

Also, this is my first time posting, so I'm hoping that nobody's done this before.

Hmm… They have, but I don't think it was clearly resolved. Off the top of my head, I'd go  Legacy,  Scholar, Ra, CR, and Tempest.

Legacy plays Inspiring Presence [damage +1] and Galvanises [damage +2].

The Scholar plays Don't Dismiss Anything:

Ra puts Imbued Fire into play [+3 damage].

CR puts By Any Means into play [+4 damage].

Scholar puts DDA into play:

Ra puts The Staff of Ra into play [+1 for Ra].

CR puts Displaced Armory into play, brings out  Compounded Bow, deals Akash 5 damage [5].

Tempest puts Cleansing Downpour into play.

Scholar puts Keep Moving into play to put a Mortal Form to Energy out, plays two more KMs for two more MFtE's, then puts Proverbs and Axioms into play:

Legacy Galvanises [+5 damage].

Scholar takes 8 damage, uses Better Living to heal 1 and deal 3x6 damage to Akash [23].

Ra uses Pyre, for 8 damage [31].

CR uses Compounded Bow, for 2x6 damage [43].

Tempest uses Cleansing Downpout; Scholar deals 3x7 damage [64].

Legacy plays Back-Fist Strike, for 9 damage. [73].

Tempest plays Vicious Cyclone.

Legacy plays Back-Fist Strike, for 9 damage. [82].

The Scholar skips his power phase.

Ra plays Flame Spike for 7 damage [89], uses Pyre for 8 damage and throws his Staff for 9 [106].

CR plays Displaced Armory to bring out Jim's Hat and deal 6 damage [112], then chains four Eyes on The Prizes and finishes up with a Terrible Tech-Strike and a shot from his Compounded Bow for a total of 49 damage [161].

Tempest discards 3 cards for Vicious Cyclone, to deal 3x6 damage [179], then plays Lightning Slash for 10 damage [189], and finally uses Cleansing Downpour to heal Scholar for 2, dealing Akash 3x6 damage [207] and thus killing her.

My set up:

[quote]MFtE deals 6 Fire damage to AZ

AZ heals himself for 18

AZ is still at 29 health, and has taken 18 fire damage

Repeat 2x for the other two MFtE.  [AZ at 29, taken 54 fire]

AZ takes 9 fire then 15, then heals 21 [AZ at 26, taken 78]

AZ uses Thermodynamics, takes 7 then 13 then heals 19 [AZ at 25, taken 98] 

Legacy plays  Back-Fist Strike on AZ.  AZ takes 8, then 14, then heals 20 [AZ at 23, taken 120]

Ra plays Fire Blast on AZ.  AZ takes 10 then heals 16 [AZ at 29, taken 130]

Legacy plays Back-Fist Strike on AZ.  AZ takes 8, then 14, then heals 20. [AZ at 27, taken 142]

[/quote]

Scholar heals himself for 1.  AZ takes 5, then 11, then heals 17 x3 [AZ at 29, taken 190]

 

Ra plays Flame Spike on AZ.  AZ takes 6, then 12, then heals 18. [AZ at 29, taken 208]

Ra uses Pyre on AZ.  AZ takes 7, then takes 13, then heals 19.  [AZ at 28, taken 228]

Ra throws his staff at AZ.  AZ takes 8, then takes 14, then heals 20.  [AZ at 26, taken 250]

I think that's the max damage you can get out of this setup, but there's a bunch of fiddly numbers involved with keeping AZ from dying, so it's possible I missed something.

 

EDITED to fix my math.

EDIT2:  If you switch out Legacy's Back-Fist Strikes for Flying Smashes, you get another 10 damage in, bringing the total to 290.  I don't want to change all the numbers a second time, though.

posts.name: JimmytheRat
posts.cooked:
jsz2, Imbued Fire only boosts fire damage, not all damage.  So all of his cold-healing is only at +5, one less than what you've listed for each step.  This means that he'd actually die during the self-damage step of the first Backfist Strike, so you'll have to lose some damage somewhere either for more healing or by using TtE to subtract rather than add.

Also, Scholar would need to have taken damage during the first villain turn to be able to get damage out of MFtE.  The on-healing trigger won't occur if he's already at full health, since his HP won't change.  It's still an impressively large amount of damage, but it's not quite as high as you've listed.

No, Flying Smash has three targets, so he can hit Scholar, AZ, and Akash all at the same time for maximum efficiency. 

 

Also, it turns out that I gave Ra two plays during the 2nd DDA.  So that's fixed now.

 

Legacy's turn:  Inspiring Presence + Galvanize

Scholar's turn:  DDA

Imbued Fire (+3)

Twist the Aether

Null Point Calibration

DDA

[quote]Isothermic Transducer

Twist the Aether

Flying Smash: -6 -11 + 15 [27 health, 17 fire damage], Scholar takes 6, Akash takes 6

Keep Moving x3, Proverbs and Axioms

[quote]Galvanize (+4 total)

Visionary heals

Pyre: -6 -12 +17 [26, 35]

Scholar heals 2:  (-6 -12 +17) x2, (-6 +11) [29, 77]

AZ takes damage:  -9 -15 +19 [25, 101]

Thermodynamics: -7 - 13 + 18 [23, 121] 

[/quote]

Living Conflagration: -6 -12 +17 [22, 139]

Flying Smash: -7 -13 +18 [20, 159] Akash takes 7 (total:13)

[/quote]

Scholar heals 1: -5 -11 +16 x3 [20, 207]

Visionary's turn:  Cerebral Hemorrhage: -6 -12 +17 [19, 225]

Ra's turn:

Flame Spike: -5 -11 +16 [19, 241]

Living Conflagration: -5 -11 +16 [19, 259]

Pyre: -6 -12 [1, 277] Akash takes 18 (total: 31)

AZ's turn: play coolant blast, blast Akash for 283 fire damage (total 314).

 

So in the end we're actually dealing more damage than last time.  The losses come from needing to heal more (and modify damage downwards with TtE once), and removing the Fire Blast that Ra shouldn't have had.  The gains came from an extra Pyre from Ra (since he wasn't needed to shoot the Scholar, because Legacy handled that with Flying Smash), the extra damage from using Flying Smash over Back Fist Strike, and skipping the healing on the last damage so that AZ could shoot Akash in the face, and switching Ra's Staff for a Living Conflagration, which gets an extra instance of damage in, and allows me to switch up the healing step to get a bit more damage in to AZ without killing him.

 

It's possible that there are more tweaks to be made, but I'm over 300 damage now, so I'm happy.
